name: SmartyColours
tagline: Free colouring pages for little hands.
shortDescription: Print free original colouring pages or colour online, with friendly tools and local picture saving.
longDescription: Print five free original pages from every SmartyColours pack in A4 or US Letter. Colour any of the 80 pictures online and save your finished picture to your device. More pages are available in the iPad and iPhone app.
featureIntro: The app keeps the tools obvious and the page central, so children can spend more time colouring.

features.title: Themed colouring packs
features.body: Original illustration packs with familiar subjects like animals, vehicles, robots, and dinosaurs.

features.title: Apple Pencil Support
features.body: Natural drawing and colouring on iPad with Apple Pencil support.

features.title: Kid-Friendly Interface
features.body: Big buttons, simple navigation, and little visual clutter.

features.title: Subscription Content
features.body: A simple subscription provides the full set of packs and future additions.

structuredData.description: A kids colouring app for iPad with Apple Pencil support, themed packs, and a simple interface.

privacySummary: Read the app privacy policy for information about SmartyColours on iPad and iPhone.

seo.title: Free Colouring Pages & Online Colouring | SmartyColours
seo.description: Print 80 free colouring pages in A4 or US Letter, or colour online with friendly tools for little hands. Original pictures, no ads and no sign-up.
seo.ogImageAlt: A smiling orange cow in a sunny meadow, from the SmartyColours Farm Yard pack

faqs.question: Are the printable packs available?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every pack has five free pages. Download the whole pack or a single sheet as an A4 or US Letter PDF, or colour any page online.

faqs.question: Do we need to sign up?
faqs.answer: No. There are no accounts and nothing to fill in. Open a picture and start colouring.

faqs.question: Does colouring online save anything about my child?
faqs.answer: No. Colouring stays in this browser tab. Save picture downloads a PNG to your device, and Share asks a grown-up first. There are no names, accounts or artwork uploads.

faqs.question: What age is it for?
faqs.answer: The pictures are drawn for toddlers, preschoolers and young children, with big shapes and thick lines.

faqs.question: What do we get in the app?
faqs.answer: Hundreds of pages across themed packs, pinch-to-zoom, and Apple Pencil support on iPad. It is free to try, with optional in-app purchases for more content.
